# Evolving_System_Resilience

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capacity of a network to maintain functionality and recover from perturbations as its topology dynamically changes over time. Addresses the dynamic reconfiguration needs of TCC systems, where interconnects must adapt to workload shifts without compromising stability.
